reference.title: Scenario 6 — Table embedded inside a list item
reference.shortdesc: Consider a bulleted list where the author has inserted a simple table directly inside one

section.p: Consider a bulleted list where the author has inserted a simple table directly inside one of the list items. For example, to present a small reference table as part of a bullet point.

row.entry: [List Bullet]: The following options are available: [Table inside list item] │ Option │ Default │ │ Retry │ 3 times │ │ Timeout │ 30 sec │

entry.codeblock:
Available Options
  • The following options are available: Option Default Retry 3 times Timeout 30 sec

section.p: Result:When the table is correctly embedded inside the list item in the .docx file, the converter nests the <simpletable> inside the <li> element.
section.note: Documents exported from Google Docs may not preserve the table-inside-list structure; verify the output and correct as needed.
